sources.citation: Daniels, Don. 2019. Repartitioning. 1-page colloquium abstract, University of Oregon Linguistics, 1 March 2019.
sources.note: Nothing on stress (only rhetorical 'we stress that'). pp. 712-713 give the complete research history of Soq [mdc] and state: 'Since the 1970s there has been no work on Soq apart from the fieldwork for this study.' The paper treats tense/person-number syncretism in verb suffixes; the only phonological remark is k->g voicing allomorphy of -kimbi/-kibi (p. 714).

sources.citation: Z'graggen, John A. 1980. A comparative word list of the Rai Coast languages, Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics D-30. Canberra: ANU. xvi+181 pp. DOI 10.15144/PL-D30
sources.note: Nothing. Intro sec. 7 (p. vii): 'The transcription of the word list is rendered in a semiphonemic form'; per-language table of fluctuating sounds includes a Male row (pp. viii-ix); no mention of stress/accent/tone anywhere (grep + read of pp. v-x). B26 Male forms carry vowel length but no stress marks (visual check printed p. 15 = PDF p. 31, saved).
